title: ACME Solar arm signs power purchase agreement with NTPC for 150 MW hybrid project #Shorts
description:
ACME Solar's subsidiary, ACME Alpha Renewables, has executed a power purchase agreement with NTPC for a hybrid power project with a contract capacity of 150 MW, as reported by Business Standard.

Sources: Business Standard
